WINDOWS RELEASE

Windows 1.5.13

Clearer guidance for elapsed time after departure and the two-hour reference.

Latest public release2026-10-13
Windows ZIP · .NET 10 x64

Windows 10/11 x64 · Requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime x64

HighlightsImprovementsSupport and limitsDownloads

Highlights

Preserves elapsed-minute display starting 30 minutes after scheduled departure, and the meal-time reference at scheduled departure plus two hours.

For an 18:00 scheduled departure, 18:29 is before the elapsed-time display starts. At 18:30 it shows 30 extra minutes; the two-hour reference is 20:00. These displays do not confirm actual work or approve a meal allowance.

Improvements

  • Calculations, the today view, and the tray share the same 30-minute and 120-minute thresholds.
  • Explains display timing, examples, and when to hide the guidance: no arrival record or a day marked off.
  • Preserves automatic arrival, manual entry, half-days, days off, history, display settings, and the stored format.

Includes the early-arrival rule from 1.5.12. While the app is running, the first valid session unlock between 06:00 and 07:59 records a regular arrival at 08:00 that day. Manual entry is not adjusted, and later unlocks preserve the first record.

Support and limits

Portable app for Windows 10/11 x64. The smaller runtime-required ZIP below needs .NET 10 Desktop Runtime x64.

Provides the tray today view, arrival editing, history, and departure countdown. Windows does not provide arrival detection at login, calendar synchronization, calendar-based half-day recognition, or in-app automatic updates. The new Mac 1.5.15 UI, optional plugins, themes, and icons are not included.

Windows code signing and actual Windows user-session GUI, unlock, login, and installation remain unverified separately. The time guidance does not replace official attendance records or payroll and meal-allowance approval.

Downloads

Install .NET 10 Desktop Runtime x64, extract the ZIP, and run HappyLulu.exe. Keep it in a fixed folder for startup registration. Quit from the tray before replacing files for an update.
